name: After recital B
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: Ba. whereas the governance, funding and oversight of public service media fall primarily within the competence of the Member States, provided that such measures are adopted transparently and in line with EU law and fundamental rights; whereas the independence of public service media should be accompanied by accountability, transparency and effective oversight, particularly where public funds are involved;
